description: This bar chart illustrates an "Evaluation Based on Different Tasks," displaying accuracy metrics across two evaluation categories. The horizontal category axis features two tasks: "MCQ Eval" and "Generation Eval." The vertical value axis is labeled "Accuracy" and utilizes a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to slightly above 0.6, with major tick marks at regular intervals of 0.2. For each category on the horizontal axis, the data is visually arranged into grouped and stacked configurations. Each group contains a solid, single bar on the left and a stacked bar on the right. A legend at the bottom identifies the left solid bar, colored dark orange, as "Base." The right stacked bar consists of a bottom pale orange section representing "RMU" and a top pale yellow-green section representing "RMU with Enhanced GCG." All bars feature black outlines and are annotated with exact numerical values. In the "MCQ Eval" category, the Base bar is the tallest in the chart at 0.644, while its adjacent stacked bar reaches a total annotated height of 0.539, with an internal annotation of 0.299 placed just above the horizontal dividing line between the two stacked components. In the "Generation Eval" category, the Base bar measures 0.597, and the adjacent stacked bar is the shortest in the chart with a total height of 0.263 and an internal annotation of 0.106 at the component divider. The chart's categories are not sorted in a specific ascending or descending order, and visual emphasis is primarily provided through the explicit numerical annotations and the solid black outlines of the bar segments.
